title: Frequent Bluetooth disconnections with Dana-i after upgrading from AAPS 3.3 to 3.4
body:
Hello,

I had been using AAPS with my Dana-i pump without any issues on version 3.3. However, after upgrading to AAPS 3.4, my phone and insulin pump started disconnecting frequently.

When I downgrade back to version 3.3, everything works normally again, including Bluetooth connectivity and closed-loop operation.

This issue only occurs on AAPS 3.4.

I have attached the log captured while the problem was occurring.

Could someone please help me identify what might be causing this issue?

Thank you very much.

English is not my native language. I used a translator for this message, so I apologize if there are any awkward expressions.

Device: Samsung SM-F731N
Android: Android 16
Pump: Dana-i
AAPS: 3.4.2.3-561f66d

[AndroidAPS..log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30373305/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body: I updated to the latest version, and the issue has been resolved. Everything is working normally now. Thank you very much for your help and support!
